item.title: S. Korea police arrest man over AI image of runaway wolf that misled authorities
item.description:
📝 The photo, circulated hours after Neukgu went missing on 8 April, prompted authorities to urgently relocate their search operation, sending them on a wild wolf chase. Authorities also presented the AI image during a press briefing on the runaway wolf, local media reported. Runaway wolf finally captured after nine-day search in South KoreaHowl recordings and an AI image: Inside South Korea's long hunt for an escaped wolfAsiaAnimalsSouth Korea.
🔗 Read more: https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c4gx1n0dl9no

item.title: Spinel: Ruby AOT Native Compiler
item.description:
📝 Spinel -- Ruby AOT Compiler Spinel compiles Ruby source code into standalone native executables. Spinel is self-hosting: the compiler backend is written in Ruby and compiles itself into a native binary. new, Fiber#resume, Fiber.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/matz/spinel
